name: projectquran
description: Source-linked Quran research web app and installable PWA

scripts.check: node --check dist/app.js && node --check dist/catalog.js && node --check dist/sw.js && python3 scripts/validate.py
scripts.android:sync: npm run check && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run check && npx cap sync ios
